name: Camp cooking spit
description: Two forked wooden stakes about 1 m high holding an iron spit with a crank and a trussed roasting bird, a sooty iron pot of stew hanging from its middle over a small fire of sticks and embers in a ring of blackened stones.

provenance.prompt: Two forked stakes with a spit and a hanging pot over a small fire, about 1.2 × 0.6 × 1 m; anchors fire:camp and light:fire.
